Name: Glock 19 Gen 5 9mm
Short description: Compact 9mm pistol, perfect for concealed carry and home defense.
Description: The Glock 19 Gen 5 is one of the most popular handguns in America. Features improved grip texture, ambidextrous slide stop lever, flared mag-well, and nDLC finish. 15+1 capacity.

Name: Smith & Wesson M&P Shield Plus 9mm
Description: The M&P Shield Plus offers a slim profile with increased capacity. Features an 18-degree grip angle, flat face trigger, and tactile/audible trigger reset. Perfect for everyday carry.

Name: Sig Sauer P365 XL 9mm
Short description: Micro-compact 9mm with 12+1 capacity and optics-ready slide.
Description: The P365 XL gives you a longer grip and sight radius in a package that's still easy to conceal. Optics-ready slide, flat trigger, and XRAY3 day/night sights included.
Tags: 9mm, Sig Sauer, concealed carry, optics ready

Name: Springfield Hellcat Pro 9mm
Description: Springfield Hellcat Pro bridges the gap between micro-compact and compact. 15+1 capacity, adaptive grip texture, U-Dot sight system, and optics-ready slide.

Name: Smith & Wesson M&P15 Sport II 5.56
Short description: Reliable AR-15 platform at a great price.
Description: The M&P15 Sport II is a proven AR-15 with Armornite barrel finish, 6-position collapsible stock, and 30-round Magpul PMAG. Chambered in 5.56 NATO/.223 Rem.

Name: Ruger 10/22 Carbine .22 LR
Description: America's favorite .22 rifle. The Ruger 10/22 Carbine features a hardwood stock, 18.5-inch barrel, and patented 10-round rotary magazine. Great for plinking, small game, and training.

Name: Henry Big Boy .44 Mag
Description: The Henry Big Boy is a beautifully crafted lever-action rifle with a brass receiver, American walnut stock, and 20-inch octagonal barrel. 10-round tubular magazine. Made in the USA.

Name: Mossberg 500 Tactical 12ga
Description: The Mossberg 500 Tactical features an 18.5-inch barrel, 6-shot capacity, dual extractors, anti-jam elevator, and ambidextrous tang safety. A proven home defense platform.

Name: Remington 870 Express 12ga
Description: The Remington 870 Express is one of the best-selling shotguns of all time. Features a 28-inch ventilated rib barrel, hardwood stock, and twin action bars for smooth cycling.

Name: Federal American Eagle 9mm 115gr FMJ (50rd)
Short description: Reliable range ammo — 50 rounds per box.
Description: Federal American Eagle 9mm Luger 115-grain FMJ. Brass case, boxer primed, non-corrosive. Excellent for range training and target shooting. 50 rounds per box.

Name: Hornady Critical Defense 9mm 115gr FTX (25rd)
Short description: Premium self-defense ammo — 25 rounds per box.
Description: Hornady Critical Defense features the patented FTX bullet with flex tip for reliable expansion. Nickel-plated cases for smooth feeding. Optimized for short-barrel carry guns.

Name: Winchester USA 5.56mm 55gr FMJ (20rd)
Short description: Standard 5.56 NATO rifle ammo — 20 rounds per box.
Description: Winchester USA White Box 5.56mm NATO 55-grain FMJ. Brass case, boxer primed. Reliable feeding and consistent accuracy for AR-15 platforms.

Name: Magpul PMAG 30 AR/M4 GEN M3
Description: The Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 is the gold standard in AR-15 magazines. Impact-resistant polymer, anti-tilt follower, stainless steel spring, and paint pen dot matrix for identification.

Name: Streamlight TLR-7A Weapon Light
Description: The Streamlight TLR-7A produces 500 lumens from a compact body that sits flush with full-size and compact pistol muzzles. Ambidextrous rear switch, 1.5-hour runtime.

Name: Safariland 7378 ALS Holster - Glock 19
Short description: Level 1 retention duty/carry holster for Glock 19.
Description: Safariland 7378 ALS concealment holster with automatic locking system. Injection-molded SafariSeven nylon blend. Open-top design with ALS retention. Belt loop included.

Name: Rugged Obsidian 45 Suppressor
Short description: Full-auto rated pistol suppressor, modular length.
Description: The Rugged Obsidian 45 is a full-auto rated, modular pistol suppressor. Converts between full and short configuration. Compatible with 9mm, .40 S&W, .45 ACP, and .300 BLK subsonic. Includes piston and spring.

Name: Dead Air Sandman S Suppressor
Short description: Versatile rifle suppressor with Keymo mount.
Description: The Dead Air Sandman S is a mid-length rifle suppressor rated for full-auto. Stellite blast baffle, Keymo quick-detach mount system. Compatible with 5.56, .308, and .300 BLK.
Tags: suppressor, Dead Air, rifle suppressor, Keymo
